title: Terms of Business: Funding Your Meal Subsidy on the Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
Your meal subsidy for employees is funded in advance, in lots. Each lot is recorded against your contract with its own funding lot reference, so that drawdowns can be traced back to the money that paid for them.

A lot may not be smaller than the minimum funding lot printed against your service model. If you wish to fund less than that, you are asked to combine the amount into your next scheduled lot instead.

A lot stays drawable for the number of months printed against your service model, counted from the day the funding cleared, and lapses at the end of that period. When a lot lapses, the rollover percentage printed against your service model is carried into your next lot, and the remainder is written off in your favour on the following invoice.

**When funding may be accepted.** Funding is only accepted onto a contract that stands mobilizing, active or suspended, since a proposal has no cafe to spend it at and a contract in transition out is being settled rather than funded. This is read from the contract's own status on record, taken before the funding is posted, for that contract alone.

Your annual subsidy commitment is measured against the sum of the lots you fund in the contract year, and a shortfall against that commitment is settled on the final invoice of the contract year rather than charged lot by lot. The minimum funding lot, the number of months a lot stays drawable, the rollover percentage on lapse, and the annual subsidy commitment are each those printed against your service model under the Workplace Cafe Management Program.
